findings: Accepted. The three defects from review f34f37bed are fixed. 1) All 29 cascade slots in unpinned-cascade-slots.txt, and all 50 distinct #slot paths in the stored chain data, are pinned. That is 22 FONT_FILES plus 41 CASCADE_FONT_FILES as font rows, and PingFang as an asset-font row. 2) A symlink OUT, a symlink ancestor under scratch, and a symlinked scratch are refused, and nothing is written. 3) A committed blank or - scalar exits 2 against every live value, including dash on both sides.

Coverage. JDK sources were read and Java was not run. They show that the reference JVM registers only the fonts Core Text enumerates, plus the logical fonts. getFontPath returns an empty path under LWCToolkit. createCompositeFont uses CTFontCopyDefaultCascadeListForLanguages plus GeezaPro, and dot-names are dropped. The corpus names 36 families. Every installed family among them resolves to a pinned file. Courier and Times resolve in Core Text to the hidden, unpinned Courier.ttc and Times.ttc, but Java cannot register them. findFont2D maps courier to monospaced, which is Menlo. The Java goldens prove it: Vault at 14 px is 42.1436, where Menlo gives 42.14355 and Courier.ttc 42.00684. Local cascades over all 25 reachable styles, with 631 languages as stored, reach no unpinned path except colossus's Reserved PingFangUI. On Monkey Man that slot is the pinned MobileAsset copy. Other system faces sit on the sealed system volume, which host.build_version pins, and all 63 font hashes are identical on colossus. The documented scope is therefore justified, though the sealed-volume reason is not written down (proposed target 3).

derive_cascade_font_files is deterministic. It gives the same 41-tuple under four PYTHONHASHSEED values. self-test rejects every stale tuple and every changed #slot dataset in stale-tuple-matrix.tsv: dropping, adding, swapping or renormalizing an entry; adding, removing or moving a slot path; a relative path; no slot lines. It accepts reordered or renamed TSVs. A census missing a non-Emoji cascade row still passes self-test, but the gate fails closed on it with check exit 1.

The check mutation matrix has 117 cases (17 exit 0, 63 exit 1, 37 exit 2). Every earlier case and every new cascade case behaves as specified: cascade faces added, removed, rehashed or renamed to NFC; census3 against census4. So do the full scalar grid and the user-font, asset-font and symlink-row hash grids. One gap remains: font rows do not apply the unpinned rule. A committed blank or - font hash exits 1 against a real live hash, and 0 when the live hash is also blank or -. record always writes a 64-hex font hash or crashes, and the Rust test rejects a short committed font hash, so no real drift is missed through the hook. The README's exit-2 wording is still wrong for font rows (proposed target 1).

Record matrix: 27 of 27 as expected. It runs the real record() with only the JVM stubbed and a write audit hook. A cascade face edited, or turned into a symlink to other bytes, exits 1 at check. A removed or dangling cascade face makes record exit 1. A symlink to identical bytes exits 0, because content and path are unchanged. No accepted case writes outside realpath(OUT). The ancestry rule is lexical: an outside alias of scratch followed by a scratch symlink is accepted and writes into that symlink's target. The hook never builds such a path (proposed target 2).

Script version. 47e68059 (which recorded census4) and the committed d4f9a562 differ only in the self-test function cascade_slot_mutation. record, its callees and CASCADE_FONT_FILES are identical. With the JVM stubbed, both versions recorded colossus to byte-identical census.txt (11dda102) and sidecars, through identical writes. That record shows no font-row drift against census4. A fresh record by the committed script on an unchanged Monkey Man therefore reproduces census4 (284d5ef4), and no request directory was needed. The relay matches SHA256SUMS and PARENT-SHA256SUMS, it is byte-identical to the committed census, and check of it exits 0.

Hook. reference_env_gate.py (d9288913) was run against a fake install, with only path constants changed. It returned only when record and check both exited 0. It aborted on check exit 1, check exit 2, record exit 1, a missing census, a missing scratch (not created), scratch as a file, and a symlinked scratch (record refuses). No temporary directory remained in any case. The documented call block was pasted before line 68 of the live seq_capture.py (eaf70825). It stops the capture before new-worker on exit 1, exit 2 and record exit 1, and lets new-worker run on a pass. The install step is exact and sufficient. The only write outside scratch is Python's __pycache__ in the install directory (proposed target 4). HotSpot hsperfdata is still untested residue.

No loss. -tsvg matches on 18878 sources: 12550 golden and 6328 perturbation, 0 mismatches. -tpng, -teps and -ttxt match on 64 sources each. -tpdf on the tip is byte-stable across runs, 64/64; base differs on 8/64. pdf_contract: 2 passed.
